subject: [PATCH] mm: filemap: move lruvec accounting outside the xarray lock

2026-09-16.patch_summary: This patch moves the accounting of lruvec statistics outside the xarray lock in the __filemap_add_folio function, reducing lock contention and improving performance. The lruvec updates are moved to after a successful XArray insertion and after releasing the xarray lock. This change is particularly beneficial for systems with CONFIG_MEMCG enabled, where per-CPU memcg and lruvec counters need to be updated. By moving these updates outside the critical section, the patch aims to reduce lock contention and optimize system performance.
